title: The MARK-B.L.U. Architecture: A Quantum Hash Function Framework for Research and Implementation of Security and Verification of Agent Identity Outputs

contributions.purpose: 提出可在NISQ设备复现的量子哈希框架
contributions.mechanism: 参数化量子电路(16qubit/3层纠缠)将经典输入编码为旋转参数,从末态振幅取签名
contributions.evaluation: 仅模拟(simulated),无硬件运行数字;Qiskit可复现
contributions.source_quote: we introduce MARK-B.L.U. ... a novel quantum hash function architecture constructed using parameterized quantum circuits explicitly designed for Secure Agent Identity

contributions.mechanism: 对熵分布、雪崩效应、碰撞抗性、比特独立性做经验测试
contributions.evaluation: 声称empirical results,但基于simulated randomness profile,论文正文未给具体数值表
contributions.source_quote: a comprehensive evaluation of the proposed architecture's behavior ... simulated randomness profile through entropy distribution, and sensitivity analysis through collision resistance, avalanche effect, and bit independence tests

contributions.purpose: 提供开源教学实现桥接理论与NISQ
contributions.mechanism: 开源Qiskit实现,面向IBM量子后端
contributions.source_quote: Bridging theoretical design and NISQ-compatible quantum cryptography by the means of an open-source implementation of the framework for educational and research use

self_declared_provenance.quote: Unlike classical hash functions or existing quantum proposals that assume fault-tolerant architectures, the MARK-B.L.U. operates within the practical limitations of current hardware

notes: 有Table 1自声明4条贡献(此处合并教学/开源为C3、限制讨论并入)。数据红旗:全部为simulated模型,作者自认'these test phases ... are of the initial simulated model',声称硬件可部署但未跑硬件(simulated baseline);正文只给贡献表,未见碰撞/雪崩具体数值,评估缺实证数字。desk-reject。无AI披露checklist(仅3页,checklist缺失)。定性研究,四元组evaluation多为非数字。
